description: Legitimate claim-denial complaint with financial hardship, distressed tone. Covers: escalation independent of label (legitimate + escalated), customerTone=distressed, route=complaints_register+review_queue, priority=urgent.
turns: My home insurance claim for storm damage was denied last week, without any explanation. I'm now in serious financial trouble because of it, I can't afford the repairs and I'm falling behind on other bills. I just want someone to explain the decision and look at reconsidering the claim. I don't have a policy number on hand, and I'd rather not share contact details right now.
